errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, which means the categories are on the vertical axis and the values are on the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly reverses this.

errors.text_span: "Не знае/Не може да прецени", "Много несправедливо", "Донякъде несправедливо", "Нито справедливо нито не справедливо", "Донякъде справедливо", "Много справедливо"
errors.evidence: The description lists the categories in an order that does not match the top-to-bottom order shown in the chart. The correct order is "Много справедливо", "Донякъде справедливо", "Нито справедливо нито не", etc.
The description lists seven categories, including a repetition of "Донякъде справедливо" (with a typo). The chart only contains six distinct categories.

errors.text_span: Скалата за хоризонталната ос е линейна, отклонената наляво до 2,1 и продължаваща до 38,3.
errors.evidence: The value axis (horizontal) implicitly starts from 0, not 2.1. The phrase "отклонената наляво до 2,1" (deflected to the left to 2.1) is an inaccurate and unclear description of the axis scale.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted alphabetically. Their order is fixed according to the scale of responses, from 'Very fair' to 'Don't know'.
The bar with the highest value (38.3) corresponds to the category "Много несправедливо" (Very unfair), not "Много справедливо" (Very fair), which has a value of 3.0.
The category label is misspelled; it should be "Донякъде справедливо".
The category label is slightly misquoted. The chart shows "Нито справедливо нито не".
When listing the values for each category at the end of the description, the category "Не знае/Не може да прецени" with its value of 2.1 is omitted.
The bar lengths do not change sequentially (e.g., they don't uniformly increase or decrease). This is a vague and inaccurate generalization.
